## Fuel mass balance

Units: per_MWh column: g U per MWh, or SWU per GWh; per-year columns: t U, or tSWU (thousand SWU).

| Quantity | per MWh | 1 unit / yr | 4 units / yr |
|---|---|---|---|
| Net efficiency (net MWe / MWt) |  | 0.3448 |  |
| Feed factor (kg natural U per kg enriched U) |  | 7.701 |  |
| SWU per kg enriched U |  | 5.422 |  |
| Enriched U (kg) | 2.685 | 6.35 | 25.4 |
| Natural U (kg) | 20.678 | 48.9 | 195.6 |
| Separative work (SWU) | 14.558 | 34.4 | 137.7 |

Working: kWh_e per kg enriched U = burnup 45 GWd/t x 24,000 kWh_th per kg U per (GWd/t) x 0.345 = 372,414. Feed = (xp - xt)/(xf - xt) with xp 3.8%, xf 0.711%, xt 0.25%. SWU = V(xp) + (F - 1)V(xt) - F V(xf), V(x) = (2x - 1) ln(x/(1 - x)).
